title: Creator portrait / Greeting
slide_intent: Show personality through expression and gesture because viewers can connect with a person before reading their name.
strategic_value: An expressive portrait against a bright color can make Twitch creators feel approachable and prominent.
demonstration: A smiling woman in a black-and-white top raises an open hand against a pink field.
practical_value: Compare gesture, crop and background color as tools for giving a creator portrait an inviting character.

content_islands.name: Portrait
content_islands.spec: Crop the figure from the torso upward, retaining her smile, gaze and raised open hand.

content_islands.name: Color ground
content_islands.spec: Use the uninterrupted pink field to separate the figure from contextual distractions.

reference_purposes.Intent: COLLINS describes Twitch as supporting creators and describes the photography as a way to elevate them and invite participation.
reference_purposes.Expression: The portrait pairs an expressive greeting gesture with an isolated pink background.
